## Checklist

- [ ] Source evidence and reference versions are recorded for data changes.
- [ ] Predictions or mixed evidence are not published as experimental endpoints.
- [ ] No credentials, private files, raw reads or publisher workbooks are included.
- [ ] Documentation and diagnostics are in English.
- [ ] Relevant checks in CONTRIBUTING.md pass.
